title: Bear One Another's Burdens, Final Warning and Benediction

questions.question: Brothers, if anyone is caught in any transgression, you who are spiritual should restore him in a spirit of ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:1 (ESV): "Brothers, if anyone is caught in any transgression, you who are spiritual should restore him in a spirit of gentleness. Keep watch on yourself, lest you too be tempted."

questions.question: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:2 (ESV): "Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ."

questions.question: For if anyone thinks he is something, when he is nothing, he ____ himself.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:3 (ESV): "For if anyone thinks he is something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself."

questions.question: But let each one test his own work, and then his reason to boast will be in himself alone and not in his neighbor. For each will have to bear his own ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:4-5 (ESV): "But let each one test his own work, and then his reason to boast will be in himself alone and not in his neighbor. For each will have to bear his own load."

questions.question: Let the one who is taught the word share all good things with the one who ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:6 (ESV): "Let the one who is taught the word share all good things with the one who teaches."

questions.question: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:7 (ESV): "Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap."

questions.question: For the one who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption, but the one who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:8 (ESV): "For the one who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption, but the one who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life."

questions.question: And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:9 (ESV): "And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up."

questions.question: So then, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to those who are of the household of ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:10 (ESV): "So then, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to those who are of the household of faith."

questions.question: Paul draws attention to his handwriting at the end: "See with what large ____ I am writing to you with my own hand."
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:11 (ESV): "See with what large letters I am writing to you with my own hand."

questions.question: It is those who want to make a good showing in the flesh who would force you to be circumcised, and only in order that they may not be persecuted for the ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:12 (ESV): "It is those who want to make a good showing in the flesh who would force you to be circumcised, and only in order that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ."

questions.question: But far be it from me to boast except in the ____ of our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:14 (ESV): "But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world."

questions.question: For neither circumcision counts for anything, nor uncircumcision, but a ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:15 (ESV): "For neither circumcision counts for anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation."

questions.question: And as for all who walk by this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:16 (ESV): "And as for all who walk by this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God."

questions.question: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 6:17 (ESV): "From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus."

key_verse_text: And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up.
